title: Meridune cuts the allocation for Impeller HI 250
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Meridune Precision Castings Co., Ltd.. Meridune cuts the allocation for Impeller HI 250. Need: 720 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 59 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 684. Prepare from the data package.
